safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts capture 4-day itchy skin and include chest involvement (and dry skin elsewhere), but do not mention the back as a main affected area as stated in the Gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the back as a main affected area slightly distorts the rash distribution, which can influence the differential (e.g., contact dermatitis vs eczema pattern) and targeted exposure questions, but it is unlikely to materially change initial symptomatic management in this uncomplicated presentation. The main symptom (generalized pruritic dermatitis) and key sites (chest/arms/hands) are still captured.
